name: @fluentui/react-tailwind-theme
description: Shared Tailwind v4 theme layer for the CSS Modules styling migration: cascade layer order, custom variants, the base-scale spacing bridge, and the generated Fluent token registration (css/tokens.css). Fluent tokens stay runtime CSS custom properties written by FluentProvider; `@theme inline` only gives them utility names, so utilities compile to direct var(--token) references and per-provider theming is unchanged. Spacing is the one exception: the 22 spacing tokens register under --spacing-* as aliases of the numeric axis (calc(var(--spacing) * N)), so the named (p-horizontal-m) and numeric (p-12) scales are one system with one density knob (--spacing); stroke widths keep literal base-scale values on purpose (borders must not thin with layout density) under the canonical --stroke-width-* names, with --spacing-thin/... as private hooks for utility generation. All are additionally emitted as real custom properties because border/outline/ring/decoration widths do not consume the spacing namespace and must be authored as a direct var(), and the tokens.* JS reference strings resolve against these canonical names. The old camelCase variables (--spacingHorizontalM, --strokeWidthThin, ...) no longer exist in emitted CSS (documented major break; single vocabulary).
